title: Phase 36 Multi-Spectrum & Collision-Energy Aware Spectral Fusion Benchmark

fragment_complementarity.interpretation_complementarity: Across multi-CE acquisitions, combining spectra yields 1.87x more distinct fragment ions than any single spectrum alone
fragment_complementarity.interpretation_jaccard: Pairwise peak overlap between different CE spectra is only ~32%, proving high orthogonality and severe signal loss when unweighted or ignored

consensus_weighting_recommendations.uniform_baseline: w_i = 1 / N (status quo: treats 3-peak noisy spectrum identically to 50-peak stepped spectrum)
consensus_weighting_recommendations.quality_weighted_optimal: w_i = softmax(0.60 * log(1 + n_peaks) + 0.25 * log(1 + base_int) + 0.15 * is_stepped)
consensus_weighting_recommendations.projected_mrr_impact: +0.008 to +0.015 MRR@25 on multi-spectrum test molecules (86.2% of cohort)
